entry.title: Mind-Only and the Middle Way: Yogācāra and Madhyamaka in China
entry.summary: Read Kumārajīva, Jizang, Xuanzang and Kuiji through the Three Treatises, the Thirty Verses, and the hundred dharmas.

entry.title: The Vinaya in China: Monastic Discipline and the Dharmaguptaka Rule
entry.summary: Explore the Four-Part Vinaya, Daoxuan’s work on Mount Zhongnan, and the bodhisattva precepts of the Brahmā’s Net Sutra.

entry.title: Tiantai and Huayan: Two Great Systems of Chinese Buddhist Thought
entry.summary: Meet Zhiyi, Fazang and Zongmi through calming and insight, the golden lion, and Chinese Buddhism’s teachings on an interconnected world.

entry.title: Pure Land Buddhism: Amitābha, the Three Sutras and the Practice of Recollection
entry.summary: Read the three Pure Land sutras and meet Huiyuan, Tanluan, Daochuo, and Shandao through Amitābha's vows and the practice of recollection.

entry.title: Chan Buddhism: From Bodhidharma to the Platform Sutra and the Lamp Records
entry.summary: Meet the early Chan teachers, read the Dunhuang Platform Sutra, and follow the five houses through the Record of the Transmission of the Lamp.

entry.title: Esoteric Buddhism in Tang Chang'an: Amoghavajra, Huiguo and the Road to Kūkai
entry.summary: Meet the teachers of Tang esoteric Buddhism and explore their scriptures, from Amoghavajra’s Chang’an to Huiguo’s transmission to Kūkai.

entry.title: The Heart Sutra: Text, Translators and How to Read It
entry.summary: Explore the Heart Sutra through Xuanzang's Chinese text, its Sanskrit mantra, and a gentle passage-by-passage introduction to wisdom and emptiness.

entry.title: The Eight Schools of Chinese Buddhism
entry.summary: Explore eight Buddhist traditions through their great teachers, foundational texts, and a practical first reading for each school.

entry.title: Start Here: Reading the Chinese Buddhist Canon
entry.summary: Find your first Buddhist text, learn how the Chinese canon is arranged, and build a reading practice with sutras, teachers, and commentaries.
